name: cle/team
title: Team
description: Headshots on clay shapes that wobble on hover. Tapping someone with a bio, LinkedIn or website opens a card about them. A person can be hidden until they should appear.

default.name: Ted Troxell
default.bio: Ted Troxell is President of CLE AI & DATA, Northeast Ohio’s 4,284-member AI and data community, and a Principal Scientist on the founding technical team at Atomic Industries, where he builds machine-learning systems for manufacturing. He has spent 13 years turning AI research into products, as an engineer, startup CTO and CEO.

default.name: Will Tatz
default.bio: Will Tatz is Chief Operating Officer of CLE AI & DATA. A community builder and AI ambassador, he brings more than 20 years in operations, project management, strategy and analytics to bringing people together, exploring new technology and turning ideas into action. He is focused on responsible AI and on making AI accessible to everyone.

default.name: Julie Novic
default.bio: Julie Novic is on the CLE AI & DATA leadership team. She is an AI transformation strategist, AI governance professional and data scientist who draws on her PhD in anthropology to design, develop and implement responsible, human-centric AI solutions.

default.name: Nicole McCaffrey
default.bio: Nicole McCaffrey is Head of Marketing and Strategy at CLE AI & DATA. She has 25 years in marketing and strategy, including leading marketing at the Responsible AI Institute and SkillSpout and serving as COO of Cleveland AI firm Pandata. She was Vice Chair of the RITE Board, the Greater Cleveland Partnership’s IT workforce collaborative.

default.name: Curtis O'Neal
default.bio: Curtis O’Neal is an AI solutions architect and data scientist on the CLE AI & DATA team. His career spans research, enterprise software, data engineering and technical leadership. He explores generative AI, agents and AI-assisted learning with hands-on curiosity and healthy skepticism, and holds an MBA from Case Western Reserve’s Weatherhead School.

default.name: Tim Nash
default.bio: Tim Nash is Community Liaison and Substack Editor at CLE AI & DATA. He is building a career in healthcare cybersecurity, protecting patient information, while studying at Valencia College. He served with AmeriCorps NCCC FEMA Corps, helping survivors of natural disasters. An Eagle Scout raised in Shaker Heights, he volunteers monthly at a Cleveland men’s shelter.

default.name: Helen Shere
default.bio: Helen Shere is Head of Mentorship and Education at CLE AI & DATA and co-founder of Data in the Land, a Cleveland community for data professionals. A Market Analyst at Cleveland Clinic and former science teacher, she brings years of curriculum design and data experience to building CLE AI & DATA’s mentorship program.
